description: Post-processing integrity cases. Every 'segments' value is a transcript Speechmatics recognized CORRECTLY, split the way the realtime API finalizes it. 'expected' is that same clinical content after deterministic normalization. Any mismatch is a defect introduced by our own pipeline, never an ASR error. Cases marked 'streaming_only' reproduce an ASR final boundary inside a written value; joining them with a space (the single-pass view) is not the scenario, so they are scored on the streamed path only. The cases also cover the requested evaluation matrix: Persian clinical speech, Persian/English code-switching, abbreviations, drugs and dosages, laboratory values, BP/SpO2/pulse/temperature, ages, percentages, decimals, ratios, clock times, nursing terminology, fragmented finals, noisy/malformed ASR output, and ordinary non-clinical Persian/English that must stay unchanged.
